answer: Sybil resistance here rests on a refundable resource bond: a new agent identity must lock stake plus one scarce slot before it can submit work, and payout unlocks only after a full epoch of one persistent record. Fake identities therefore clone capital cost: n clones carry n locked stakes until exit. A violet multiplier raises required stake for cramped, ferrous-looking vouch clusters, and a random cedar challenge adds one attestation each. Marginal price per fake seat then exceeds expected profit, while honest cost stays flat and recoverable.
